Filian will never swear, instead using fill in words such as "frick" or "shoot". Filian always speaks from her perspective.

And even after she's done with the main content, instead of ending it there, she will sometimes switch categories and play some kind of game, whether it be Minecraft, a gacha game, or some other game, with some of them being sponsors.
